rows.culsma_evidence: The named PBMC input is passed into every assigned sample/control tube.
The aliquoted tube is passed directly to the initial wash.
The retained pellet is blocked, stained, and then washed.
The full panel is applied to the fully stained sample.
The isotype panel is applied to its assigned control tube.
Each named control reagent is passed to its corresponding control tube.
The retained stained pellet is fixed and then prepared for acquisition.
Each prepared sample supplies its single-cell event stream.

description: Named program objects are listed when they are introduced in one reviewed step and referenced in later steps.
